metaTitle: How to Choose an RV Outdoor Rug
description: Choose an RV outdoor rug by size, woven recycled-plastic material, drainage and anchoring, with sizing tables for awnings and cleaning tips.
directAnswer: Size the rug to about 6 inches inside your awning (often 9 x 12 or 10 x 20 feet), pick a woven recycled-plastic polypropylene rug that drains and dries fast, choose a mid-tone color and stake or weigh down the corners.
